text:
maya: quick weekend brainstorm — micro-adventure or full hibernation? whos up for one short plan vs zero plans?

devon: micro-adventure if it involves snacks. otherwise i'm team duvet. :zzz:

sarah: thinking of hosting a tiny craft-and-coffee meetup saturday morning (10am). low effort: bring a mug, bring a thing to mend / decorate. 

henry: craft or nap. depends on whether anyone has spare duct tape and a morale-boosting playlist.

leo: im plotting a 12mi gravel loop north of town, coffee stop at mile 8. leaving 8:30am. anyone slow-rolling ok?

emily: gravel loop sounds rad but 12mi scares me. can i join just for coffee at mile 8? :)

maya: options: 1) sarah's craft + coffee 2) leo's gravel + coffee stop 3) duvet/solo chill. react with :one: :two: :three:

devon: :one: (i like the idea of adhesive fixes)

leo: :two: (slow pace, promise)

sarah: :one: i'll have tea, spare needles, and a box of random buttons. also small table for plant photos.

emily: :one: or :two: depending if i can be brave before 9am

henry: :three: need to recover from week. but i'll bring a playlist suggestion for future meetups.

maya: craft option edging out. i'll bring a tiny pastry sampler and a daft walkie-talkie for sarah's button box.

calendar-bot: Heads up — Community Room reserved saturday 9:30-11:30 for "DIY & Coffee". Please tidy after.

maya: cool — final call: sarah's at 10am. bring a mug, a thing to mend, or just show up for pastry. if you want the gravel coffee only, meet leo at the 4th st taco truck at 9:45.

leo: folks joining coffee-only, DM me and i'll share the exact pin.

devon: pastry for everyone please. see u saturday!

maya: will post a quick yes/no for pastry count. also pro tip: those who choose duvet, we will set up a consolation playlist.
